The lighting is soft, characteristic of late afternoon or early evening. (3) A man in a black jacket and trousers walks away from the camera, pulling a large orange suitcase and a smaller patterned one on a paved walkway under a bright, white-walled building. (4) The scene cuts to the interior of a black luxury van, showcasing plush black leather captain's chairs with adjustable headrests. The camera pans to reveal the spacious legroom and high-end finishes of the cabin. Another shot shows fireworks or smoke rising near a traditional temple roof at night. (8) Back inside the van, the woman is seen reclining in the leather seat, demonstrating the electronic adjustment buttons on the armrest. (9) The woman stands in a quiet residential street in Tokyo next to the black van wearing a yellow sweater and a denim jacket. A series of quick cuts show Tokyo cityscapes, including a Lawson convenience store, a shelf of Maneki-neko cats, and a chef preparing sushi. The video ends with the woman laughing happily at night.
